name: Terrance Goldsworthy

tenures.source: Billed throughout the promotion's own official handbook as its founding owner, and named again in an active wrestler's own promo that April.

caption: The promotion's own founding owner, credited in its handbook with every major signing, press release and public appearance.

name: Albert Vasquez

tenures.source: Billed in the promotion's own official handbook as its commissioner.

caption: The promotion's own commissioner, billed as its in-house lawmaker over matches, vacancies and suspensions.

name: Trevor Hall

tenures.source: Billed in the promotion's own official handbook as one of its two main commentators.

caption: One half of the promotion's own commentary team, billed as one of its best-liked broadcasters.

name: Jean Lamont

tenures.source: Billed in the promotion's own official handbook as its other main commentator.

name: Wayne Vengeance

name: "Sweet as Silver" Midas Runt

name: "The Diabolical Bastard" Rip Fury

tenures.source: Named as Midas Runt's own billed opponent for a debut match on "Legends of Wrestling"; no roleplay or result of his own survives.
